subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the three indexed transcript writer facts as documented Plugin SDK APIs for bundled Codex and Copilot mirrors, or should this optimization remain behind a narrower owner-controlled seam?
rationale: The patch is not only an internal optimization: it adds and documents new public Plugin SDK methods whose long-term semantics and external-plugin support obligation require maintainer product and API-boundary intent.

options.title: Sponsor the generic SDK contract
options.body: Accept the three writer facts as supported Plugin SDK APIs after current-head proof confirms both mirror behavior and the dirty-index fallback.

options.title: Keep the optimization owner-scoped
options.body: Replace the new public methods with a narrower internal or bundled-plugin seam if maintainers do not want these persistence details to become a Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the three writer facts as supported Plugin SDK APIs after current-head proof confirms both mirror behavior and the dirty-index fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged generation-aware transcript foundation and this direct follow-up, so they are best positioned to explain the intended contract before a maintainer sponsors it.
